translations.web: They also gave me poison for my food. In my thirst, they gave me vinegar to drink.
translations.bsb: They poisoned my food with gall and gave me vinegar to quench my thirst.
translations.kjv: They gave me also gall for my meat; and in my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink.
translations.asv: They gave me also gall for my food; And in my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink.
